title: Titanium Dioxide (TiO2): EU Ban, US Status & Global Compliance
excerpt: Titanium dioxide is banned in EU food since August 2022 but remains an authorized color additive in the US under 21 CFR 73.575. FDA review is accelerating under MAHA pressure.
seo_title: Titanium Dioxide FDA Status 2026: EU Ban vs US Authorization & What Companies Must Know | Policy Canary
seo_description: Titanium dioxide regulatory status: banned in EU food (2022), permitted in US under 21 CFR 73.575. FDA review accelerating. Action steps for compliance.

structured_data.fda_status: Authorized color additive (21 CFR 73.575, max 1% by weight)
structured_data.eu_status: Banned in food (Regulation (EU) 2022/63, effective August 2022); permitted in pharmaceuticals

international_reviews.review_context: FDA expedited review; MAHA report; citizen petition FDA-2023-C-1487; Food Chemical Reassessment Act of 2025 (H.R. 4306)

key_deadlines.label: California Food Safety Act effective (TiO2 excluded but related additives banned)

key_events.description: EFSA publishes safety assessment concluding genotoxicity concern cannot be ruled out
European Commission adopts Regulation (EU) 2022/63 banning E171 in food
EU food ban fully effective; no new products with E171 permitted
FDA reaffirms safety of TiO2 for food use under 21 CFR 73.575
California AB 418 signed without TiO2 (removed during legislative process)
Mars removes TiO2 from US Skittles production
MAHA report names TiO2 as food chemical of potential concern
Food Chemical Reassessment Act of 2025 (H.R. 4306) introduced, listing TiO2 as first-priority for FDA reassessment
EU Commission issues SWD confirming continued TiO2 authorization in pharmaceuticals (EMA review)
